name: code-skills
description: Engineering discipline with ten generic quality gates for any language: no shortcuts, secrets, file size, project checks, tests, coverage, complexity, duplication, dead code, and vulnerable dependencies.

interface.shortDescription: Engineering discipline and strict quality loops.
interface.longDescription: Applies behavior-preserving engineering discipline and loops through ten generic gates (no shortcuts, secrets, file size, the project's own lint/type/format/build checks, tests, coverage, complexity, duplication, dead code, and vulnerable dependencies) on the agent's change until every applicable gate passes.
defaultPrompt: Use code discipline while implementing and verifying this change.
Run the repository quality loop and fix every issue until it passes.
